Title: Azure Cosmos DB Data Migration tool imports from Azure Table storage

Body.Content:
The Azure Cosmos DB Migration Tool has been updated to enable you to import data from Azure Table storage. You can now import data from JSON files, MongoDB, SQL Server, CSV files, Azure Cosmos DB collections, and tables. The Azure Table storage source importer option enables you to import from an individual Azure Table storage table and optionally filter the table entities to be imported. The updated source code can be cloned from the GitHub repository. The updated compiled version is available from the Microsoft Download Center. To learn more about the Azure Cosmos DB Data Migration tool, you can:

  • Read the blog announcement: New Azure Cosmos DB Import Options
  • Review the tutorial: Import data to Azure Cosmos DB

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
